name: Giant type, picture passing
look: Two to four words set at 12vw with a photograph showing through the letters under a 65% ink tint, dark enough to read over any photograph; the photograph passes upward through the type as the section crosses the screen.
reduced: The photograph stands still inside the letters.
phone: It runs on a phone with the type smaller (19vw) and two thirds of the travel: the photograph still passes up through the letters.

needs.picture: mid to dark tones with detail, no pale sky; the lower half of the picture is what shows
needs.words: a statement of 2 to 4 words and one line under it
